name: cc-usage-plugin
description: Claude Code usage ledger from hooks: per-session repository, model, skill, command and token metadata plus commit, PR and edit counts, never prompt content; optional batched upload to an HTTPS receiver. Windows/macOS/Linux, Node 22.23.4+ / 24.22.1+ / 26.12.1+, zero dependencies

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Your own handle, assigned per person and unique after normalization (e.g. alex); uploads need it. Stamped on every record and used as your folder name on the receiver: lowercased, with letters a-z, digits, '.', '_' and '-' kept and anything else turned into '-'; a value with nothing left becomes u-<hash>. Empty: the OS login name, local ledger only.

team.title: Team
team.description: Team label attached to every record (e.g. platform)

endpoint.title: Receiver URL (optional)
endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint (plain http only to 127.0.0.1 or localhost) that accepts POST of NDJSON batches and answers 202. Leave empty to keep a local ledger only.

token.title: Receiver token (optional)
token.description: Shared token, sent as the X-Webhook-Token header

flush_hours.title: Upload interval (hours)
flush_hours.description: Upload about once per this many hours (default 24); earlier when 64 KB are waiting. A failed upload is retried on its own schedule (30 min, doubling to 6 h).
